---
name: Task
about: Work to do that is not a review finding (a roadmap item, a tool, docs)
title: "short statement of the work"
labels: ["task"]
---

- Goal: what is true when this is done.
- Where it comes from: a PR's differences that remain, the discussion,
  the issue it was split from.
- Milestone: the current one unless it belongs to a later phase; the
  `roadmap` label if it is a part not yet implemented, or a difference
  from procnto in the QNX personality.
- How it is checked: the test, the probe, the command.
